_ghi_chu: EN-ALL GĐ 6 — mẫu câu tiếng Anh của bài đọc quẻ Kinh Dịch (kinhdich_doi_song, kinhdich_tra_loi), khởi quẻ (kinhdich_api, kinhdich_hien) và quẻ ngày riêng. Ban biên tập viết, chờ người bản xứ duyệt. Thuật ngữ (Six Lines, Plum Blossom, Self / Other line) chỉ ở phần 'Why we say this'.
kd.dung_than_chua_lo: the line that stands for your matter has not appeared yet
kd.qh.the_khac_dung: you have a grip on the matter, but it costs effort
kd.qh.ty_hoa: both sides are evenly matched — go with the flow
kd.qh.the_sinh_dung: you have to give a lot
kd.ly.dai_dien: the line that stands for the matter ({chi}, {hanh}) is {tong} for this month and day

kd.ly.nguyen_dong: the line that feeds the matter is moving
kd.the_que.can_cu: {que}{bien}: {cu}. The book adds: «{trich}» — the line for your matter comes first; the hexagram's overall pattern is only a secondary note.
kd.nl.loi_chu: The text that leads (Zhu Xi's rule): {tieu_de} — 「{han}」 {dich}
kd.nl.bien_nguoc: The text of the resulting hexagram {que} points the other way from the leading text → overall level: Balanced.
kd.mh.the_dung: The Body trigram {the} ({hanh}) stands for you; the Use trigram {dung} stands for the matter. {ten}: {y}
kd.mh.toan_cuc: The whole picture measured against the Body trigram — {qh}.
kd.mh.ung_ky_so: The hexagram number is {so}: for near matters count it in days, for distant ones in weeks or months — this is a suggested rhythm, not a forecast.
kd.lh.dung_than: The deciding line ({dt}) is line {vt} ({chi}, {hanh}), spirit {thu}; by the month: {nl}, by the day: {nt}.
kd.lh.phuc: The deciding line ({dt}) is hidden under line {vt} ({chi}, {hanh}); the line on top of it is {phi}.
kd.td.moc: The nearest date worth watching: a {chi} day ({ngay}), {ly} — in {n} days.
kd.td.theo_lh: By the Six Lines method, the nearest date is a {chi} day ({ngay}).

kd.hop.de_vap: Where it is easy to slip
kd.hop.co_the: The part of the body to keep an eye on
kd.hop.co_the_loi: The old texts (the Shuo Gua) link the lower trigram {quai} of this hexagram with {he} — if you notice discomfort there, arrange a {kham} so a doctor can check. {mien_tru}
kd.doan.chuyen: The matter is gradually moving into {que}: {y}
kd.doan.hao_dd: Seen through the line that stands for your matter: {y}.

kd.cc.mai_hoa: Plum Blossom — Body, Use, nuclear, changed

kd.cc.the_que: Six Lines — the hexagram's overall pattern (Zeng Shan Bu Yi)

kd.qt.0: No changing lines — read the JUDGMENT of the primary hexagram. There is no resulting hexagram.
kd.qt.1: 1 changing line — read the LINE TEXT of line {a} of the primary hexagram.
kd.qt.2: 2 changing lines — read the line texts of lines {a} and {b} of the primary hexagram; the UPPER line ({b}) leads.
kd.qt.3: 3 changing lines — read the JUDGMENTS of both the primary and the resulting hexagram; the primary shows the present situation, the resulting one shows where it leads.
kd.qt.4: 4 changing lines — read the line texts of the 2 UNCHANGING lines ({a}, {b}) of the RESULTING hexagram; the lower one ({a}) leads.
kd.qt.5: 5 changing lines — read the line text of the unchanging line ({a}) of the RESULTING hexagram.
kd.qt.6_can: 6 changing lines in Qian — use 'All Nines' (Yong Jiu).
kd.qt.6_khon: 6 changing lines in Kun — use 'All Sixes' (Yong Liu).
kd.qt.6: 6 changing lines — read the JUDGMENT of the resulting hexagram.
kd.uk.ra_khong: it leaves the void (the line's own day)
kd.uk.xung_khong: a day that clashes the void — what has been on hold is woken up
kd.uk.mo_mo: a day that opens the line's 'storehouse' — what was stuck comes out
kd.uk.dong_hop: the moving line is tied up, waiting for a clashing day to free it
kd.uk.hop_dong: a day that combines with the moving line
kd.uk.tinh_xung: a still line waits for a clashing day to set it moving
kd.qr.cach_khoi: Plum Blossom by numbers: {a} → upper trigram, {b} → lower trigram; add the hour number ({gio}) → changing line.
kd.qr.cach_khoi_ngay: Plum Blossom: year + month + day of the lunar calendar → upper trigram; add the Zi hour → lower trigram and changing line.
